queries_run: Flex Ltd credit rating 2026 customer downgrade OR guidance cut OR bankruptcy

findings.claim: FY2026 前十大客戶占淨銷售 45%（FY2025 44%、FY2024 37%），無單一客戶超過 10%；Cloud 與 Power Infrastructure 集中度尤高，由少數超大規模雲端業者主導，且可能自製或轉單。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Our ten largest customers accounted for 45%, 44% and 37% of net sales in fiscal years 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively. No customer accounted for more than 10% of net sales in fiscal year 2026, 2025 or 2024.

findings.claim: 截至 2026-03-31，單一客戶占應收帳款淨額 16%，幾乎全在 CPI 部門；前兩年無客戶超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: A single customer accounted for 16% of the Company's total balance of accounts receivable, net as of fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, which is almost entirely within the CPI segment.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未找到客戶信用惡化、降評、下修財測或破產的 2026 來源；最新評級資料為 S&P 2024-11（BBB-），未核到 2026 新動作。

clues.claim: S&P 2024-11 對 Flex 評級報告，列失去關鍵客戶為可能降評因素之一
